name: rates-bonds/treasury-flow-calendar
title: Treasury flow calendar — TLT month-end / FOMC / pre-auction
description: Three pre-announced Treasury flow effects netted into one TLT weight in {-1, 0, +1}: long the last 3 trading days of each month (index duration extension), long the day before and the day of each FOMC statement, short the 2 trading days before every 10y and 20y auction incl. reopenings (dealer concession).

backtest.cost_type: all-in (spread + fee), charged per unit of turnover

live_notes: SIM book: filled at the yfinance daily close with no order book, rejection or partial fill. Weaker evidence than a venue fill; do not read this Sharpe as exchange-cleared.
Cost: broker set to 1 bp slippage + 1 bp fee = the research's 2 bp/side all-in. The report's cost ladder: 5 bp -> Sharpe 1.02, 10 bp -> 0.60. Do not rebuild it with the 10 bp default.

Borderline vs its 'Sharpe >= 1' brief: selection-free estimates are below 1 (walk-forward 0.75-0.88, 2002-09 ETF holdout 0.63, 1990-2009 synthetic 0.87-0.89). The report's honest live expectation is Sharpe 0.9-1.2. The OOS 1.57 is not clean for window selection (report §3).

Health check: the pre-auction short leg is a post-2010 issuance-regime feature (≈0 Sharpe 1990-2009) and is the first thing expected to break if auction sizes shrink. Month-end + FOMC alone ≈1.0 over 36 years.

Calendars: FOMC from the committed snapshot, which ends 2027-12-08 -- refresh calendars.py before then. Auctions = snapshot ∪ TreasuryDirect securities/upcoming, fetched each run and persisted to data/treasury_auctions_seen_live.csv; if that endpoint is down the short leg goes flat, the long legs are unaffected.

Known live-vs-backtest gap: ~6% of 10y/20y auctions (mostly reopenings) were announced one day after the first short-signal close; the date was on Treasury's tentative quarterly schedule, but the upcoming endpoint does not list it yet, so live skips the first short day on those.
strategy.py's NYSE holiday table observes New Year on Friday when Jan 1 is a Saturday; NYSE does not. Next occurrence 2027-12-31: the December 2027 month-end window will be one day early in live.

Runs at 00:00 UTC (after the NYSE close) and trades only when the TLT bar changes; a mid-session restart refuses today's forming bar. round_trips_per_year = turnover_per_year / 2 (spec: ≈66 one-way unit weight changes per year).
